title: 外套

series.next: 那个人 has sent a message with more than one character: 嗯嗯。

setting: The noodle shop, Monday lunchtime, the same table. 阿峰 has a jacket in a carrier bag on his knees.

steps.en: This jacket counted as a person, you know.

else.zh: 你说衣服不算人……我现在还难受。
else.en: You said a jacket doesn't count as a person... I still feel bad.

steps.zh: 今天下午，我要还给那个人。当面。
steps.en: This afternoon I'm giving it back to them. In person.

steps.zh: 不能洗。洗了，人家以为你嫌弃。
steps.en: Don't wash it. They'll think you found it dirty.
A friend of mine says you fold it into a square.

say.en: Advise 阿峰: wash it, then give it back.
say.gloss: Wash it, then give it back.
say.tip: 再 zài = then (after that): 洗一下再还 = wash it, and then return it.

answers: 还是洗一下再还吧，干净点。
3.gloss: Better wash it first, then give it back. Cleaner.

steps.en: Say nothing. Put it down and walk away.
Just say thank you. Come on, practise.

say.en: Rehearse his line with him: thank you for your jacket.
say.tip: 外套 wàitào = jacket, coat. 谢谢你的…… = thank you for your ...

answers: 你就说：上次谢谢你的外套。
3.gloss: Just say: thank you for the jacket, last time.

steps.zh: 要是那个人说不客气呢？要是不说话呢？要是……
steps.en: What if they say you're welcome? What if they say nothing? What if...

say.en: Calm him down: don't overthink it!
say.tip: 别想太多 = don't think too much: the friend's cure for everything.

3.gloss: 阿峰, relax. Don't overthink it!

steps.narr: The door opens. 那个人 walks in, wearing a jacket. The same jacket.

steps.zh: 我朋友说，那个人一直有两件。
steps.en: A friend of mine says they've always had two.

steps.narr: 那个人 looks at the carrier bag, then at 阿峰, and goes a little pink.

steps.en: So... the first one was an excuse.
老秦 is right, for the first time ever.
So now what? Do I give it back or not?

say.en: Tell 阿峰 to keep it, or to give it back anyway.
say.tip: 留 liú = keep, hold on to: 你留着吧 = you keep it.

ok.narr: 阿峰 puts the bag under the table, and doesn't take it out again. Then he waves.

then.narr: 阿峰 walks over and holds out the bag.
那个人 takes it, and nods. Twice.

answers: 你留着吧，下次穿着去见人家！
3.gloss: Keep it, and wear it next time you see them!

answers: 还是还给人家吧，再约下次。
alts.gloss: Give it back anyway, and make a plan for next time.

steps.en: Two people in the same jacket, in the same noodle shop, pretending not to notice. 🧥

else.en: The jacket goes home. 阿峰 walks out as if he were floating. 🧥
